title: A locked quote: a dollar price, the rate it was priced at, and the only raw that settles it
description: The rate is read once, at quote time, by the seller. Nothing on the settlement or refund path reads a rate; `lock` seals amount_raw together with the usd and rate it came from, so a tampered rate cannot survive. Validated by quotelock.check_quote, which also verifies the checksum and the digest - this schema alone is not sufficient.

usd.description: Dollar price, exactly 4 decimal places, greater than zero.

rate_xno_per_usd.description: XNO per one USD, exactly 10 decimal places, greater than zero. The seller supplies this number; this package never fetches, recommends or endorses a rate.

amount_raw.description: ceil(usd * rate_xno_per_usd * 10**30). The only amount that ever settles. 1 XNO = 10**30 raw, so this is an integer string and never a binary fraction.

pay_to.description: Checksum-validated by quotelock.check_quote before use; the pattern alone is not sufficient.

expires_at.description: Must be strictly after issued_at. now == expires_at is still payable.

lock.description: blake2b(canonical, digest_size=32) over v, nonce, usd, rate_xno_per_usd, amount_raw, pay_to, issued_at, expires_at joined by a newline with no trailing newline. Held at runtime only: validate.py refuses any committed file carrying 64 hex characters standing alone, because a Nano seed looks exactly like that, so vectors/quote-lock-v1.json pins this digest as two halves plus its preimage instead of as one literal.
